text:
zoe: quick experiment idea for next weekwe need a short webinar + two landing flows to see which message pulls higher-quality MQLs. primary axes: economics vs reliability.

zoe: proposed tests: 1) "Slash your serving bills" (econ), 2) "99.9% live for user-critical apps" (reliability). keep headlines short.

tom: love it. can we also test a neutral product-first headline: "Unified inference across hosted, dedicated, private"? might convert platform teams.

devin: +1. funnel wise we should route econ clicks to the demo sandbox, reliability to request-a-call, product-first to a tech whitepaper.

ana: small nit: legal will want numbers flagged as "typical" or attribution. avoid exact % unless we can cite an internal benchmark.

zoe: noted. we'll use soft claims like "teams see up to 3x lower token cost" and tag as "typical customer results".

carl: for battlecard copy vs infra vendors: quick rebuts for each headline: econ -> "You don't need to own models to optimize serving cost; our runtime, batching, and caching drive savings." reliability -> "Fallback routing, model variants, and SLA-backed pools keep apps live." product-first -> "Same API, different deployment models  no rewrite." keep each <2 lines.

devin: can we prepare 1-liners for SDRs to handle procurement Qs: pricing model, data residency, SLAs. e.g., "Pricing: usage + reserved options; we surface per-route cost breakdowns in Console."

zoe: yes. SDR snippets: pricing, compliance, rollout timeline. i'll draft.

deploy-bot: task created: MKG-landing-7812. Two route variants: /webinar-econ?utm=mk and /webinar-reliability?utm=mk. Staging preview available at https://staging.redwood.test/landing/7812

tom: creative ask: 3 hero images (econ/product/reliability), 2 headline copy variants each, and alt CTAs: "Try the demo" vs "Book a reliability briefing".

ana: legal-bot: quick checklist: avoid absolute guarantees; tag benchmarks; get compliance sign-off for "data residency" claims. I'll review copy by Wed.

legal-bot: review task created: LEG-942. Expect sign-off in 48 hrs after copy update.

zoe: timeline: landing up Wed AM, creatives by Tue EOD, SDR playbook by Wed noon, ads run Thu
or 5 days. small budget $1.2k. monitor CTR -> qualified lead rate.

devin: analytics: capture `lead_type` checkbox (exploring-hosted, reserved, private) + utm_source. use `/webhook/lead-api` for immediate SDR notifications.

carl: reminder to include a short slide in webinar showing a simple benchmark: p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and a note about batching + KV cache. label as "internal test results".

zoe: exactly. final deliverables: landing variants + UTMs, 6 headline variants, SDR rebut snippets, benchmark slide, legal sign-off. i'll drop the draft battlecard in #marketing for quick iter review Thu morning.

tom: i'll mock hero slides and copy options; pinging design. :paintbrush:

devin: adding calendar block Fri review.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: MKG-landing-7812 deploy check Wed 09:00 UTC."
